integrity: E and Linux frozen manifests and payloads verified before each job; pinned raw model weights verified before owned readiness alias.

external: Wrapper success is not measurement success: per-engine MEASURED/UNMEASURED must be read.
scientific_limits: R4/M2 matched-capacity supplemental studies do not resolve author contribution choices, physical GPU pin claims, or original no-think M1/M2 gates.

maintenance: Windows full-process cmdline inventory exceeded heartbeat lifetime. Filter by process name before Python-candidate command-line reads; retain all foreign Python/model server guards.
